title: Jamaican Jerk Tender Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic tagine dish made with tender meat infused with the bold flavors of Jamaican jerk seasoning.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the jerk seasoning, tagine spice mix, and brown sugar, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, chicken broth, and salt, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve the tagine over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
